facts: Sheriff sales are held every Friday at 9:00 a.m. online at franklin.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov (in person at the Franklin County Courthouse, 373 S. High St., only when a court orders it). No sales on federal holidays.
Properties are advertised for three consecutive weeks in the Tuesday Columbus Dispatch, which the Sheriff calls the legal source of information.

Bidders must register with Realauction and have the deposit ($2,000 / $5,000 / $10,000, set by law) in place: wires by 5 p.m. two business days before, ACH by 4 p.m. seven days before the Friday auction.
Properties open for proxy bidding at least seven days before the sale.
Real Estate Sales unit: (614) 525-4231. Clerk of Courts Civil Division (case files): 345 S. High St., (614) 525-3621.
The Pickaway County Sheriff posts each sale date (with its property list) on its Sheriff Sales page.

Pickaway County foreclosure sales are run on the state's official sheriff sale website, pickaway.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov. Some court-ordered sales are instead run by a private selling officer, as Ohio law allows.

Foreclosure sales are held online on Wednesdays at 9:00 a.m. (when properties are listed) at union.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov; bidders register with Realauction and complete the Purchaser Information Form.
Deposits ($2,000 / $5,000 / $10,000 set by law) must reach Realauction: wires by 5 p.m. two business days before, ACH by 4 p.m. five business days before.
Delinquent-tax sales posted by the Sheriff are held in person at the Veterans Memorial Auditorium, 233 W. 6th St., Marysville.
The Sheriff posts a PDF list for each sale date on its Sheriff Sales page.
Since Aug 22, 2022 Holmes County foreclosure sales are held online at holmes.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov.
The Sheriff's Sales page lists current sales with case number, plaintiff, appraisal and sale dates.
Questions: Sgt. Roger Sprowl, sgtrog@holmescountysheriff.org, (330) 674-1936, Mon–Fri 8 a.m.–4 p.m.
Foreclosure sales are online only, every Monday at 9:00 a.m. at highland.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov; tax-delinquent sales (when scheduled) are Wednesdays at 9:00 a.m.
Legal notices are published in the Saturday edition of The Daily Legal News.
Balance is due within 30 days of confirmation.
Sheriff's Office: 130 Homestead Ave., Hillsboro, (937) 840-6240.
Sales are held online on Fridays at 9:00 a.m. at washington.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov unless the ad says otherwise.
Minimum bid is generally 2/3 of the appraised value; three local residents appraise, often from the exterior only.
Sales are advertised in the Marietta Times legal notices, usually on Tuesdays for three weeks before the sale.
Sheriff's Office: 309 Fourth St., Marietta, (740) 376-7070.
Since Nov 1, 2022 sales are online at shelby.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov, Wednesdays at 10 a.m.
Sales are advertised in the Wednesday Sidney Daily News; current sales are listed in the Shelby County Sheriff's Office phone app.
Sheriff's Office: 555 Gearhart Rd., Sidney, (937) 498-1111.
Since Nov 17, 2022 sales are online at williams.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov, Thursdays at 1:00 p.m.
The county posts a Current Sheriff Sales table at williamscountyoh.gov/538/Current-Sheriff-Sales (empty as of Oct 26, 2026).
Butler County sheriff sales are run on butler.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov.
Sheriff's Office: (513) 785-1000.
Hamilton County sheriff sales are run on hamilton.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov.
Sheriff's Office: (513) 946-6400.
Since March 12, 2026 all Lucas County sheriff sales are on lucas.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov.
